metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a hat on the wrong peg, the Errors plot, and the days from Whit Monday to the twentieth.

yesterday: The hat was on the wrong peg. Cowley took twelve paces and came in on "anon." At two you played Errors.
The plot named you among the players.
Heminges has the comedy for Monday the ninth. He asked for a Labour's Won at Michaelmas. You said you have a king, about to be unkinged.
Burbage said Michaelmas, when the Inns are back. Bryan asked about the Master. You said it is in the chronicle. Kemp asked his part.
Some of the summer's takings may be kept back if playing thins. Trinity term is the twentieth, eighteen days off. Tomorrow the Theatre plays Two Gentlemen at two, and you are in it.
